'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**[[2023 Kandahari Bazar bombing]]
***Four people are killed and 15 others are injured when a [[Car bomb|motorcycle bomb]] targeting a [[Balochistan Police|police]] vehicle [[explode]]s in [[Quetta]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/10/deadly-blast-hits-police-vehicle-in-pakistans-quetta-official (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A 15-year-old [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] boy is killed by [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] in [[Jericho]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/10/israeli-army-kills-palestinian-settlers-march-to-illegal-outpost (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2023 Rutgers University strike]]
**The staff of [[Rutgers University]] vote to go on the first strike by academics in the school's 257-year history, affecting over 67,000 students in the U.S. state of [[New Jersey]]. [https://www.npr.org/2023/04/10/1168931155/rutgers-university-faculty-strike (NPR)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 10 people are killed and 25 others are injured in a [[bus crash]] in the [[Department of Lima]], [[Peru]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230411/462a000e5a8a4f3881ce2efbddf04778/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[United States documents leak of the Russian invasion of Ukraine|2023 Pentagon document leaks]]
**U.S. officials confirm that [[Classified information|top secret]] [[U.S. government]] documents relating to the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine|war in Ukraine]] have been leaked on [[social media]], revealing details of [[Ukrainian military]] vulnerabilities. [[United States Department of Defense|The Pentagon]] refers the leak to the [[United States Department of Justice|Department of Justice]], which has opened a criminal investigation into the leak. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/intel-leak-has-us-officials-bracing-impact-home-abroad-2023-04-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Louisville shooting]]
**Five people are killed and eight others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a bank in [[Louisville, Kentucky|Louisville]], [[Kentucky]], [[United States]]. The perpetrator, who [[livestreamed crime|livestreamed]] the attack on [[Instagram]], is also killed. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/04/10/us/louisville-kentucky-shooting.html (''The New York Times'')]
*A [[Local people's court|people's court]] in [[Linshu County]], [[Shandong]], [[China]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] prominent [[human rights]] and [[democracy]] activists [[Xu Zhiyong]] and [[Ding Jiaxi]] to 14 and 12 years in prison, respectively, for subverting state power. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/apr/10/china-jails-two-leading-human-rights-lawyers-after-closed-door-trial (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3216519/china-rights-activists-jailed-subverting-state-power (''South China Morning Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Israeli judicial reform protests]]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] reverses his decision to dismiss [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|defense minister]] [[Yoav Gallant]], after the latter had spoken out against the government's [[2023 Israeli judicial reform|controversial judicial reform proposal]]. [https://www.spiegel.de/ausland/israel-netanyahu-holt-entlassenen-verteidigungsminister-joav-galant-zurueck-a-4c7538e0-d78b-44e9-9819-4477b6e366b5 (Spiegel)]
